properties.coordinate_basis: GNIS point for Onigum (47.10944, -94.54472); no public source pins the exact mission site, described only as 'at Leech Lake' and later associated with the Onigum south shore.
properties.date_detail: Rev. William T. Boutwell (American Board) arrived October 4, 1833; established a school; built a bark house, then a mud-walled cabin; left after marriage and the birth of his first child; Oberlin missionaries followed and were driven away after about three years.
properties.name: Boutwell mission, Leech Lake

properties.coordinate_basis: GNIS point for Onigum (47.10944, -94.54472) with a small display offset (~200 m) so this point does not stack on the Boutwell mission and Old Agency pointers; the offset is display-only, not a surveyed location.
properties.date_detail: Unincorporated community on the south shore of Leech Lake; seat of the Leech Lake Agency until 1898.
properties.name: Onigum

properties.coordinate_basis: Onigum GNIS point with a small display offset (~250 m) so this pointer does not stack on the Boutwell mission point; the offset is display-only. No public source pins the exact Old Agency building site.
properties.date_detail: Agency opened after the 1855 treaty (funds appropriated 1856); log buildings including mission house and blacksmith shop; on the south shore of Leech Lake at Onigum; contact point until 1898.
properties.name: Leech Lake Agency - Old Agency site

properties.coordinate_basis: Placed about 2.5 miles west of the Old Agency pointer, on land near present-day Walker. The bearing/direction across the water is NOT stated in the sources consulted, so this bearing is a display placeholder only; the exact New Agency site is not pinned. THPO/Band confirmation needed.
properties.date_detail: After the Battle of Sugar Point (October 5, 1898) the agency moved to a new location on a peninsula about 2.5 miles across the water from the Old Agency; established by Act of Congress approved March 1, 1899, with $15,000 appropriated for buildings; moved to Cass Lake in 1922; abolished 1922 and assigned to the Consolidated Chippewa Agency.
properties.name: Leech Lake Agency - New Agency site (1899)

properties.coordinate_basis: Community-level pointer at Walker (GNIS 47.09972, -94.59778). Exact building site not mapped; no building footprint.
properties.name: Leech Lake Indian Boarding School

properties.coordinate_basis: Community-level pointer at Cass Lake (city). Exact building site not mapped; no building footprint.
properties.name: Cass Lake Boarding School
